tagline: 美能达便携相机，2000 年发布
description: 美能达于2000年推出的便携相机。配备1:5,4-1:6,6/22,5-45mm zoom (4 lenses)。快门速度lens shutter with speeds 8 sec down to 1/500 sec.。infrared (?)。

specs.曝光测光: dual-segment metering through meter window, range EV 4-17 (ASA 200)
specs.快门: lens shutter with speeds 8 sec down to 1/500 sec.
specs.取景器: magnification 0.32x - 0.57x, field of view 85% when distance is 3m
specs.闪光灯: reaching as far as 5.1 meters with ISO 400 film and the zoom lens in wide angle position
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Vectis 2000 is a well designed fine small compact zoom camera of Minolta's Vectis series for the Advanced Photo System (APS) with built-in flash.
